item.title: Ballard Creek Fire burns over 400 acres near Matador
item.description: MOTLEY COUNTY, Texas -- According to the Texas A&M Forest Service, a wildfire near Matador burned over 400 acres Friday. The fire, dubbed the Ballard Creek Fire, was 85 percent contained, as of 7:40 p.m. Friday after burning 406 acres north of Matador. This is an ongoing situation. EverythingLubbock.com will provide updates when available.

item.title: 5 people injured in Lubbock after Saturday morning crash
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- On Saturday, March 7, Lubbock police responded to an accident, around 9:54 a.m., near 19th and I-27, that left two people with serious injuries and three other individuals with moderate injuries. This is currently an ongoing investigation; check back with EverythingLubbock for updates.

item.title: Updates released in fatal Central Lubbock crash
item.description: The Lubbock Police Department's Major Crash Unit released an update to Friday night's fatal crash that occurred at 42nd Street and Memphis Avenue.

item.title: One confirmed deceased after motorcycle crash Friday night near 53rd Street
item.description: The Lubbock Police Department has announced that the motorcycle driver from last nights crash near 53rd Street and Indiana Avenue was pronounced deceased after being transported to University Medical Center.

item.title: Texas Tech sweeps through Big 12 opener with Houston
item.description: No. 2 Texas Tech turned its focus to Big 12 play this weekend with a three-game opening set against Houston. Despite the change in competition, the Red Raiders continued to roll in a dominant sweep over the Cougars.

item.title: Texas Tech pauses business travel to the Middle East
item.description: Texas Tech University announced on Saturday that the university is temporarily pausing all business travel in the Middle East due to current security alerts issued by the U.S. Department of State.

item.title: Shallowater head basketball coach hospitalized after crash
item.description: According to a press release from Shallowater ISD, head boy's basketball coach Jay Lusk and his family were involved in a vehicle accident during their trip back from San Antonio on Friday.
